problems.problem: Contact detail crop [14,1041,589,1291] confirms a shadow IS present at the base (offset_y 0 is correct, do not move it), but it reads as a narrow grey smudge spanning only the middle ~60% of the 415px base width and sitting a few pixels below the base edge line, so the bottle's corners appear to hover; the shadow must span the full base footprint and tighten to the base line.

The declared backdrop is a vertical glazed tile WALL (frontal grout cross at x~540/y~710 with no perspective convergence), yet the bottle carries a floor-style contact shadow; with no horizontal support plane or tonal floor band, the grounded shadow contradicts the wall reading and the bottle looks pasted onto a wall plane.

A stray dark speck artifact sits at approximately (580,390) on the tile, immediately left of the TOM FORD logo and colliding with the intended 2px ceramic spine line at x=578; it reads as a render defect, not as the designed bookspine rule.

The right text column is optically loose versus the references' locked grids: logo (418-436), title (518-548) and subtitle (648-666) leave ~82px and ~100px uneven gaps, the 43px title is small against a 922px hero (ratio ~0.047), and the column floats in empty tile with no anchor, so hierarchy reads timid rather than editorial.

The bottom ~18% of canvas (y 1181-1440) is dead empty tile under the bottle while the text column stops at y=666, leaving the lower-right quadrant vacant; the two-column grid is not vertically balanced the way the reference layouts distribute weight across the frame.

changes.value: Large-format glazed ceramic tile plane in pale celadon white, hairline grout seams, one shallow vertical groove right of center, soft satin glaze sheen; plane recedes from a horizontal support surface at the bottom third into a seamless vertical wall above, broad diffuse frontal light with cool ceramic bounce, gentle tonal fall-off low in frame, pristine clean surface, no objects
